sentences.text:
2024 
 Page 1 of 2
 Sk,J
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.9655 of 2018
Order:

1. This Writ Petition is filed questioning the action of the respondent No.2 in making efforts in laying the road through the petitioner's plot in Sy.No.128, situated in Chemiryala Revenue Village and Gram Panchayat, Kodad Mandal of Suryapet District and sought a direction to the respondent Nos.1 and 2 not to lay the road through the subject plot of the petitioner.

2. Heard the learned Counsel for the petitioner and the learned Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development, appearing for respondents.
3.

The learned Counsel for the petitioner would submit that while admitting the Writ Petition this Court passed interim orders on 23.03.2018 directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner without following due process of law and since then the respondents are not interfering with the possession of the petitioner over the subject plot.

The learned Standing Counsel for Gram Panchayat basing on the counter filed by respondent No.1 would submit that the Gram Panchayat is laying CC road confining to the existing road only but not laying in any others' property, much less the property of the petitioner and requested to dismiss the Writ Petition.
5. In view of the same, the cause in the Writ Petition does not arise and consequently this Writ Petition is closed.

However, if the respondents wants to acquire the subject plot of the petitioner they have to follow the rules as contemplated under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
